body:
### Description

This PR adds an opt-in `metrics.addLabels` config to the `chat-completion`, `messages-api`, and `responses-api` middlewares, controlling which API Management attributes are appended to the gen_ai metrics they emit. Three flags are available: `appId` (from the `Hub-App-Id` header => `app_id` label), `appName` (`Hub-App-Name` => `app_name`), and `userId` (`Hub-User-Id` => `user_id`).

The label injection logic is now factored out into a shared `pkg/middleware/aimetrics` package so the three middlewares stay in sync, and a shared `pkg/testutil/aimetrics` helper centralises the assertions used by the new `TestAPIManagementLabels` table tests.

### Breaking change

Before this PR, `chat-completion` and `responses-api` emitted `app_name` and `app_id` automatically whenever the `Hub-App-Name` / `Hub-App-Id` headers were present (no config involved). With this PR, both labels — along with the new `user_id` — require explicit opt-in. Operators relying on `app_id` / `app_name` in dashboards or alerts must update their middleware configuration before upgrading, otherwise the labels stop being emitted.

```yaml
metrics:
  addLabels:
    appId: true
    appName: true
    userId: true
```

Related to https://github.com/traefik/hub-issues/issues/2470
title: feat: add API management gen_ai metrics support
